text_block_list.text:
Following her Debut race, Mejiro McQueen 
was lost in deep emotion as she took one 
step closer to the Tenno Sho.

Wanting to win the race dear to her 
grandparents' memories and earn the honor 
of a true stayer, she shared her feelings 
toward the Tenno Sho—

She resolved to make good use of the time 
remaining until spring and hone her 
abilities even further.
